'''Tibro''' was an astronomical object<ref name="WbC" /> located in the [[Tibro system/Legends|Tibro system]], a part of the [[Baronos sector/Legends|Baronos sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Beyla Rus]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on Tibro<ref name="WbC" /> in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].<ref name="Date">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Wanted by Cracken'' translate to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. In addition, ''Wanted by Cracken'' states [[Beyla Rus]] is thirty-one years old. Rus must have therefore been [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].</ref> Tibro was also the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Human female [[Maxig Kress]].<ref name="GG10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tibro was first mentioned in the [[1993]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], which was written by [[Louis J. Prosperi]] for [[West End Games]].<ref name="WbC" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Tibro [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body Tibro, in grid square N-9.<ref name="TEA" />
